facts.fact: The Judiciary of Zambia's 2022 annual report says operationalisation of its case management system remained in limbo because funds for customising the software were unavailable, with registries brimming with paper.
The Judiciary's 2022 annual report says it continued uploading decisions of the superior courts, cause lists, notices and press statements to its website.
